page.overview:
Who is Shevan Gadarin?

She was very tall and thin, not much short of bony, with an angular face, a long chin, and a cap of curly hair. She has spidery fingers.

Shevan can be very dry at times and she frequently was.

Shevan is of high average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of the series. She is stronger than the minimum stated strength needed to Travel.

Shevan was 157 years old; she was born in and went to the White Tower in the series. After four years as novice and six as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year.
